title: Hotplug overflow test MAX_SLOTS assumption
description: test_hotplug_queue_overflow() in wp11_test_pkcs11.c injects 64 events assuming the slot table has at least 64 free slots. If WP11_MAX_SLOTS is less than 64 or slots fill before 63 events, wp11_test_inject_flash_event may silently no-op and the dropped==0 assertion passes spuriously. Need: static_assert or runtime check that MAX_SLOTS >= 64 before the loop, or restructure the test to use a single reused path that does not consume new slots.
